instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The instruction needs a verb that makes Glitch use the stimpak on himself, but the page only offers depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse. Since Glitch already holds the stimpak, there is no item transfer and no movement or speech action that carries out jabbing the stimpak into his own arm.
